title: What Bitcoin's “Halving” Means
summary: Roughly every four years, the reward paid to Bitcoin miners for adding a block is cut in half. This is the halving, and it is written into Bitcoin's rules.
blocks: Roughly every four years, the reward paid to Bitcoin miners for adding a block is cut in half. This is the halving, and it is written into Bitcoin's rules.
The effect is to slow the rate at which new bitcoin is created, tightening supply growth over time until the maximum of 21 million is approached.
It is a scheduled, predictable event, not a surprise. Its market impact is much discussed, but the mechanism itself is simply a programmed cut to new issuance.
